Container.Name: decypharr
Container.Overview: Decypharr is a self-hosted, open-source download client that integrates with multiple Debrid services. It provides a user-friendly interface for managing files and supports popular media management applications like Sonarr and Radarr.

Config.Name: TailScale Fallback State Directory
Config.Description: Fallback container directory for tailscale state information - Added By Community Applications

Config.Name: PUID
Config.Description: Run-as user ID. Set to 99 (nobody) to match the *arr containers so they can delete decypharr-created download folders.

Config.Name: PGID
Config.Description: Run-as group ID. Set to 100 (users) to match the *arr containers.

Config.Name: UMASK
Config.Description: Umask for created files/folders. 002 = group-writable, matches config.json umask.
